title: Wellposedness and dynamics of two types of reaction--nonlocal diffusion systems under the inhomogeneous spectral fractional Laplacian
summary: Reactio-nonlocal diffusion equations model nonlocal transport and anomalous diffusion by replacing the Laplacian with a fractional power, capturing diffusion mechanisms beyond Brownian motion. We primarily study the semilinear problem \[ \partial_t u + ε^2(-Δ)_g^αu = \mathcal{N}(u) \] allowing constant inhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition $u|_{\partialΩ}=g$. To handle the boundary constraint, we use a harmonic lifting to reformulate the problem as an equivalent homogeneous system with a shifted nonlinearity.
